name: Disneyland Troubadour Tavern Specialty Loaded Baked Potato (Chicken Pot Pie or Pulled Pork Mod)
whyItWorks: Troubadour Tavern tops giant fluffy baked Idaho Russet potatoes with rotating comfort fillings like creamy Chicken Pot Pie velouté or slow-smoked Pulled Pork.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for any raw slaw, crispy onions, or spicy sauces on the side, eat the soft potato flesh and tender meat, and leave the outer potato skin behind.
watchOuts: Leave the fibrous potato skin on the tray and take lactase if choosing a creamy topping
